_status: DATASET v2.0 (confound-reduced), created 2026-10-10 on user request ('remove the known confounds'). Derived from pilot_config.json (v1.1). NOT yet approved; Stage B for v2 not run.

scenes.look: v1.1 look (sky gradient, striped ground, shaded sphere, bounce e=0.6, 9 s) with the ground shadow REMOVED
scenes.blue_note: protocol blue (60,140,235) scaled in linear light to equal Rec.709 relative luminance of orange (0.2710 vs 0.2702)
scenes.start_positions: 12 = 4 x0 values x 3 y0 values; ids p00..p11

render.pix_fmt: bgr0 (RGB-native lossless; chosen to resolve review item I-07)
render.physics: free fall + vertical bounce with restitution 0.6, constant vx, no friction; identical to v1.0 until first impact (5.25-7.95 s)

input.note: unchanged from v1.0: source indices 0,4,...,60 only; frames 61..270 never enter the encoder

model.layer: final post-LayerNorm encoder tokens, hierarchical output disabled
model.pooling: mean over 4608 tokens, no L2 norm

readers.split: leave one start position out; 44 train / 4 test (22 orange / 22 blue, 22 per gravity)
readers.scaling: train-only mean + single scalar RMS scale; degenerate if s_f <= 1e-12
readers.solver: dual: W = A^T (A A^T + n*lambda*I)^-1 (Y - Ybar); linear solve, no explicit inverse

decision.primary: E_full, E_proj < min(E_CV, E_prior) and rho <= 1.10

stage_b_v2: NOT IMPLEMENTED until dataset v2 is approved; stage_b.py is hard-wired to 24 clips / 6 folds
